[Section] Experiments ::: Imbalanced Labels
[source_id=68] We next study a different problem setting where the training data of different classes are imbalanced. We show the data weighting approach greatly improves the classification performance. It is also observed that, the LM data augmentation approach, which performs well in the low-data setting, fails on the class-imbalance problems.
